body:
I became fascinated with the Meth+GHB combo from reading experiences of it. I've never tried it, and am in a position in my life where I'm drug tested often, however GHB is not tested for, and I'm prescribed adderall so I can take that. I have a fair amount of experience with both. My state of mind was stable, and I had been sober from everything before this. Over the course of the day I took repeated doses of both, albeit lowish-moderate ones until the end of the night. This report contains a warning about this combo, one that I haven't seen mentioned
. One that pertains to GHB like drugs
when mixed with stimulants.
I started the day off with 30mg of adderall IR at roughly 12pm. At about 3pm I dosed roughly 2g of pure GHB powder, and redosed every 2ish hours until 2am when I double dosed to sleep. Both drugs seemed to negate the effects of the other. It was not intense, but decently pleasant. At about 5-6pm I took another 30mg adderall. I was mildly stimulated but also somewhat sedated. Normally this dose of adderall would have me very stimulated, with negative side effects such as shaking, jaw clenching, and sweating. The GHB didnt allow these symptoms to happen. It was a fairly social combo. I enjoyed talking (normally dont). And did not appear under the influence. At around 8pm I head off to a hotel with my 2 good friends.
We talked a little while, although I felt tired as the apparent effects of the Adderall were weaning off. I wanted to have sex but felt too tired to perform well. However I did watch porn compulsively for a little bit. Mixing adderall and porn is a very bad combination, because it quickly becomes a dual addiction. I cant go out in public on amphetamines without a strong desire to indulge, occasionally hiding out in a restroom for a much longer time than I intend to.
At about 2am, I decide to drink 4G of GHB dissolved in soda, aiming to pass out. Normally this would force me to sleep. I felt like I was crashing from the addys. But even after long it had worn off I couldn't sleep. So I drank 2G more of G to induce a slumber. Last thing I remember was being at a vending machine downstairs, and throwing up shortly after. I tried turning on a bluetooth speaker but could not figure it out, even though I've done it many times before. I fell asleep at 2am, assuming my friends did the same. However they stayed up for another 2 hours to make sure I was okay. I wake up at 4am from the dopamine/glutamate rebound, and could not go back to sleep. I watch more porn, until my friends wake up at 8am. After this I learned about the events that happened before I fell asleep.
After puking, I was told that I become extremely restless. I paced back and fourth, clutching my hair in an overwhelmed type fashion (in a bad way). For the next 1.5 hours, I apparently spun in circles repetitively, until I would fall over and hit the walls or furniture.
I apparently spun in circles repetitively, until I would fall over and hit the walls or furniture.
My friends tried stopping me. I would stop for a few seconds, then completly forget what we were talking about and start spinning around again. I kept pouring more doses of G, but would drop them before drinking. I pissed on the bathroom floor, and also a trashcan in the hotel hallway. When I got nausea I would spit. I spit on the floor and the bed over and over. I was told to stop. I would consider what they said, then forget and keep doing it. I was in a heavy blackout clearly but wasnt forced to sleep by the G as I usually would be.
I'm actually lucky that nothing worse happend. I easily could've awoke in a hospital with tubes inside me or in a jail cell.
I would not take a moderate amount of both, I would take a small amount of stims and semi moderate of G, or vice versa.
Overall it was an okay combo, up until I pushed the limits.
